item.title: tcpflow: fix IP payload length out-of-bounds read
item.description:
Resolves #581365

Fixes CVE-2026-119600 by preventing tcpflow from reading beyond captured packet data when processing IPv4 and IPv6 packets.

Validate the IPv4 header length and clamp declared IP payload lengths to the actually captured data.

  • Reproduced heap-buffer-overflow in both IPv4 and IPv6 using AddressSanitizer on the unpatched build.
  • Verified both cases pass with the patch applied.

item.title: libimobiledevice: validate AFC packet lengths
item.description:
Resolves #579703

Also adds my as maintainer.

This fix should also be backported to the affected release branches.

Fix insufficient validation of AFC packet lengths in libimobiledevice 1.4.0.

The AFC packet header contains 64-bit entire_length and this_length fields, which are later used to calculate buffer sizes and read lengths represented as 32-bit integers.

The patch validates packet lengths before converting them to uint32_t:

  • Rejects invalid header and packet lengths.
  • Prevents integer truncation when calculating payload sizes.
  • Handles allocation failures gracefully.

Tested with this regression test, written with the assistance of ChatGPT.
